content:
deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout for inference-runtime v2.3.0
deploy-bot: Change window 2026-03-25 02:00 UTC -> 02:30 UTC. Affects hosted API + routing plane. Canary first per region.

sara: oncall here. FYI last minor runtime patch caused ~10m p50 blip in us-west1. recommend: canary pin to model-v2.2.1, and strict fallback rules.

mike: noted. I'll add pin and fallback: if latency > 500ms OR 5xx rate > 1% for 2m -> immediate rollback to model-v2.2.1. Also add smoke step before promote.

lucy: ops will pre-warm 2 GPUs per region at 01:30 UTC and bump autoscale headroom.

ana: draft email + status page text ready. sharing below — please sanity check wording and rollback blurb.

sam: keep comms conservative: "expected no customer-facing downtime; small chance of brief transient errors (<=5 minutes)". include support contact and request-id header name.

deploy-bot: rollout snippet:
```
# canary in us-west1
rdeploy apply --env=prod --region=us-west1 --subset=canary --image=inference-runtime:v2.3.0 --canary-pin=model-v2.2.1
# wait + smoke
sleep 180
rundeck run smoke-tests --job=smoke-gen --concurrency=5
# promote if ok
rdeploy apply --env=prod --region=us-west1 --subset=all --image=inference-runtime:v2.3.0
```

mike: smoke should hit /v1/generate with small payloads. fail fast on any 5xx or p95 > 600ms.

infra-bot: smoke job queued (id: smoke-1768300010-1).

infra-bot: smoke finished — 60/60 ok, p95=52ms, no 5xx for canary in us-west1.

lucy: promoting us-west1 canary -> all. no anomalies. moving to eu-west1.

statusbot: Status page update posted: "Planned maintenance: inference runtime update — Mar 25 02:00 UTC. Expected no downtime; rolling canaries may cause transient errors."

ana: Email draft to customers:
```
Subject: Planned maintenance — inference runtime update (Mar 25)
Hi there,

We're performing a scheduled update to our inference runtime on Mar 25 at 02:00 UTC. We expect no customer-facing downtime. During the 30-minute window you may see brief transient errors (5xx/504) while canaries roll. If you see issues, please contact support@redwood.com and include the request id header `x-redwood-request-id` for faster triage.

Client-side recommendations: use exponential backoff + jitter, and retry idempotent requests.

Rollback plan: automatic fallback to the previous stable runtime (model-v2.2.1) will trigger if latency or error thresholds are exceeded.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Ops
```

sara: please add exact thresholds in the support KB link. Also call out that paid customers can request a maintenance mitigation window.

ana: added link to KB and note about paid mitigation. updated email and queued send to paid/support subscribers at 02:25 UTC.

lucy: eu-west1 done, no regressions. starting ap-southeast1.

infra-bot: full rollout completed at 02:18 UTC. health checks green in all regions.

deploy-bot: deploy marked successful. canary pin auto-lift in 2h.

statusbot: Status updated: Maintenance complete — no incident. Posted timeline and link to release notes: https://docs.redwood.com/release-notes/v2.3.0

ana: outbound email sent at 02:25 UTC. closing thread.
